summary: Frontend testing of manual approval workflow. Created 2 fresh leads via API (TEST_ApproveMe, TEST_RejectMe, both language=en, email=info@ashtor.net). Logged into /admin and verified: (1) lead-approve-{id}/lead-reject-{id} buttons render on new leads; (2) clicking approve replaces buttons with lead-approval-badge-{id}='Approved' and shows toast 'Lead approved — access email sent'; (3) clicking reject triggers window.confirm (auto-accepted) and shows badge='Rejected'. Welcome page /welcome/eZlPd9G-1OsImEfcMXQU8Dc94S5oZYtl renders welcome-card with welcome-approved-badge='ACCESO APROBADO' (Spanish auto-switch confirmed), greeting includes 'TEST_Approval User', 3 welcome-step-* elements, both CTAs present; welcome-cta-match navigates to /. Invalid token /welcome/not-a-real-token shows welcome-invalid card with 'Invalid or expired link' and welcome-home-link. Regression: leads table still shows status pills, note/reply/files buttons, CSV export button; landing page loads normally. Backend API /api/leads/approval?token=garbage&action=approve returns 400 as expected.

minor.issue: Returns 403 instead of 400 when action query param is omitted. With action=approve/reject it correctly returns 400. Real one-click emails always include action, so functionally OK, but may want to normalize.
